task: Wallet Public Trade History Ingestion Design v1
strict_rules_observed: no wallet connection or private keys
seed-wallet allowlist only in first implementation

architecture.mode: future bounded read-only ingestion from public endpoints only
primary_flow: fetch bounded activity TRADE pages with cache-first lookup
write raw page JSONL and fetch manifest before normalization
cross-check first bounded /trades page per wallet
join existing positions/closed positions snapshots where available
join market metadata/endDate for observed markets only
optionally join narrow CLOB prices-history windows and external BTC/ETH/SOL reference snapshots in later bounded task
export deterministic CSV and Parquet where local dependencies allow
architecture.raw_hashing: canonical JSON with stable key ordering and SHA-256 for each row plus each page
architecture.deterministic_rebuild: raw JSONL is the source of truth; normalized exports must rebuild byte-identically from raw inputs and fixed versioned rules

first_ingestion_scope.metadata_join_scope: only markets observed in bounded wallet activity rows
first_ingestion_scope.price_history_join_scope: design-only now; future implementation may fetch narrow windows around normalized activity rows only
first_ingestion_scope.binance_reference_join_scope: design-only now; future implementation must use existing/as-of reference snapshots or bounded public reference queries

join_plan.purpose: Adds expiry/endDate, market title, outcome token map, active/closed status
join_plan.risk_control: Quarantine conflicting condition_id->slug mappings; preserve both raw values

join_plan.right_source: activity rows, trades rows, positions rows
join_plan.purpose: Validates that activity and aggregate snapshots refer to same market
join_plan.risk_control: Do not infer a missing condition_id from title alone

join_plan.right_source: activity/trades rows and market metadata token maps
join_plan.purpose: Confirms Up/Down/YES/NO outcome label and outcome index
join_plan.risk_control: If endpoint outcome conflicts with metadata, mark conflict and keep raw endpoint label

join_plan.purpose: Cross-checks aggregate average entry, realized PnL, current/closed status
join_plan.risk_control: Aggregate positions do not prove individual fills; use as validation only

join_plan.purpose: Adds Polymarket token price path before/after wallet activity for repricing context
join_plan.risk_control: Query only small windows around known activity rows in future implementation

join_plan.purpose: Adds external return windows around entry for Binance-lag analysis
join_plan.risk_control: Wallet endpoints alone cannot prove lag; require as-of reference snapshots

join_plan.left_keys: wallet_id, condition_id, token_id, outcome, side, timestamp
join_plan.right_keys: group by lifecycle_group_key ordered by timestamp
join_plan.purpose: Supports entry/exit candidate grouping, partial exits, approximate hold time
join_plan.risk_control: Do not collapse unmatched rows into copyability claims

validation_gates.threshold: 100% for wallet_id, source_endpoint, activity_timestamp, transaction_hash, condition_id, token_id, side, price, size, source_fetch_timestamp, raw_payload_hash
validation_gates.action_on_fail: fail normalized export; quarantine bad rows

validation_gates.threshold: <= 1% duplicate dedupe_key rows before dedupe and 0 duplicate dedupe_key rows after dedupe
validation_gates.action_on_fail: fail report and inspect endpoint/page overlap
fail export if required timestamps cannot be parsed

validation_gates.threshold: >= 95% market_type not unknown for normalized rows
100% classification for rows whose slug/title contains BTC, ETH, SOL, Up, Down, or updown
100% rows have source_endpoint, source_fetch_timestamp, raw_payload_hash, raw_page_hash, normalization_version
two rebuilds from raw JSONL produce identical CSV hash and identical JSON report hash
wallet count, rows per wallet, pages per wallet, retries, and endpoint names remain within ingestion_limits.json
validation_gates.action_on_fail: abort fetch before writing normalized outputs

validation_gates.threshold: no authenticated requests, wallet/private-key code, order endpoints, capture campaigns, holdout files, or live execution paths touched
report coverage for market metadata, closed/current positions, price-history, and Binance/reference joins; do not impute missing joins
validation_gates.action_on_fail: warn and retain explicit unavailable flags

successor_task: Wallet Public Trade History Ingester Fixture Implementation v1
